executive_brief: A Python-based CLI To-Do List Manager utilizing a local JSON file for persistent storage. The system implements a service-oriented architecture to decouple command-line parsing from business logic and data I/O, enabling core task management operations including creation, completion, listing, and removal.

architectural_constraints: Sequential ID assignment for task creation
Strict JSON serialization for data persistence
Human-readable and JSON output modes for task listing
Blocking dependency: Foundational phase must be complete before any User Story implementation
Manual smoke test validation for all core commands (add, list, complete, remove, clear)

maturity_assessment: The project specifications are highly stable and logically sequenced, with a clear dependency graph from infrastructure to feature delivery. While there are minor gaps regarding explicit security and performance constraints for the JSON storage, these are negligible for a CLI tool of this scope. The project is READY for execution.
critical_dependencies: JSON file I/O helpers in src/todo_manager/storage.py
Task entity definitions and serialization in src/todo_manager/models.py
Shared service-layer error handling in src/todo_manager/service.py
Referential integrity between CLI commands and service-layer logic
Persistence of removals and clears in the local JSON store
